reference.governing_rule: Every late uk-data target family, dataset-level anchor, and credibility check has a Microcosm home or an explicit Chesterton fence.
reference.inventory_nature: A sha-stamped snapshot of the incumbent's target-bearing modules, re-extracted manually against a local checkout and committed. CI checks the parity concerns against the committed snapshot; the recorded per-file hashes are re-verified against a tree only by verify_uk_data_target_inventory_against_tree (env-gated test or by hand), so 'uk-data moved' is caught on re-extraction, not continuously.
reference.issue_citation_rule: Incumbent issues are cited as uk-data#NNN.

status_definitions.blocked_source: Cannot proceed without pinned source evidence.
status_definitions.ported_local_bound: Declared, compiled, and admitted to the local solve.
status_definitions.ported_local_declared: Declared and compile-accounted on the local contract; solve binding still requires adjudication.
status_definitions.ported_national: Represented on the Microcosm national target surface.
status_definitions.reviewed_exclusion: Deliberately not ported after review, with a complete fence.
status_definitions.routed: Owned by another named workstream or report-only validation lane.
